title: Let yourself be kept like a child
summary: The heart blossoms when it lets the Guru become its shelter. Lean where you are already being held.
takeaway: Lean where you are already being held.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: The heart blossoms when it lets the Guru become its shelter.
source.lifeApplication: When you feel small, ask to be held before you try to harden again.
